import requests, numpy as np, os, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
W="/tmp/w"; os.makedirs(W,exist_ok=True)
def get(url,path):
    r=S.get(url,timeout=180); r.raise_for_status(); open(path,"w").write(r.text); return path
def parse_cif(p):
    cols=[];A=[];inl=False
    for l in open(p):
        if l.startswith("_atom_site."): cols.append(l.strip().split(".")[1]); inl=True; continue
        if inl and l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            d=dict(zip(cols,l.split()))
            A.append(dict(name=d["label_atom_id"],resn=d["label_comp_id"],resi=int(d["label_seq_id"]),
                          xyz=np.array([float(d["Cartn_x"]),float(d["Cartn_y"]),float(d["Cartn_z"])]),b=float(d["B_iso_or_equiv"])))
        elif inl and l.startswith("#") and A: break
    return A
def parse_pdb(p):
    A=[]
    for l in open(p):
        if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            try: xyz=[float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]
            except ValueError: continue
            A.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),alt=l[16],resn=l[17:20].strip(),chain=l[21],
                          resi=int(l[22:26]),xyz=np.array(xyz),b=float(l[60:66] or 0)))
    return A
get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q3MIX3-F1-model_v6.cif",f"{W}/a5.cif")
get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/5I35.pdb",f"{W}/5i35.pdb")
a5=parse_cif(f"{W}/a5.cif"); c8=[a for a in parse_pdb(f"{W}/5i35.pdb") if a["chain"]=="A" and a["alt"] in " A"]

# ---------- PART 1: is the KxGQ-to-kinase-domain placement confidently predicted? ----------
j=S.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q3MIX3-F1-predicted_aligned_error_v6.json",timeout=180).json()
j=j[0] if isinstance(j,list) else j
pae=np.array(j["predicted_aligned_error"],float)
plddt=np.array([a["b"] for a in a5 if a["name"]=="CA"]); idx=np.array([a["resi"] for a in a5 if a["name"]=="CA"])
print("PAE",pae.shape,"nCA",len(plddt))
def blk(lo,hi): return np.arange(lo-1,hi)
KX,KIN,NT=blk(131,186),blk(190,440),blk(1,80)
res={}
for nm,(x,y) in {"within KxGQ":(KX,KX),"within kinase core":(KIN,KIN),"KxGQ vs kinase core":(KX,KIN),"N-term tail vs kinase core":(NT,KIN)}.items():
    sub=pae[np.ix_(x,y)]; res[nm]=sub.mean()
    print("PAE %-28s mean %6.2f  median %5.2f  frac<5A %.2f"%(nm,sub.mean(),np.median(sub),np.mean(sub<5)))
print("mean pLDDT  KxGQ %.1f | kinase core %.1f | N-tail %.1f | K147 %.1f | Q150 %.1f"%(
      plddt[KX].mean(),plddt[KIN].mean(),plddt[NT].mean(),plddt[146],plddt[149]))
site5=[206,207,208,209,210,214,226,228,301,315,316,317,318,362,364,365,367,381,382]
ps=pae[np.ix_([146,149],[s-1 for s in site5])]
print("PAE of K147/Q150 against the 19 nucleotide-site residues: mean %.2f max %.2f"%(ps.mean(),ps.max()))

# ---------- PART 2: sequence-independent structural alignment ----------
def ca(atoms,lo,hi):
    d={}
    for a in atoms:
        if a["name"]=="CA" and lo<=a["resi"]<=hi: d.setdefault(a["resi"],a["xyz"])
    r=sorted(d); return np.array(r), np.array([d[i] for i in r])
r1,X1=ca(c8,251,647); r2,X2=ca(a5,130,460)
L1,L2=len(r1),len(r2); d0=max(1.24*(min(L1,L2)-15)**(1/3)-1.8,0.5)
print("\nstructural alignment input: COQ8A 5I35 %d CA (res %d-%d), ADCK5 model %d CA (res %d-%d), d0=%.2f"%(L1,r1[0],r1[-1],L2,r2[0],r2[-1],d0))
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc); U,Sv,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    D=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))]); R=Vt.T@D@U.T; return R,qc-R@pc
def fit(pairs):
    if len(pairs)<6: return 0.0,None,None
    i=np.array([p[0] for p in pairs]); jj=np.array([p[1] for p in pairs]); P,Q=X1[i],X2[jj]
    keep=np.ones(len(P),bool)
    for cut in [99,8,6,4.5,3.5,3,3]:
        R,t=kabsch(P[keep],Q[keep]); dd=np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1); nk=dd<cut
        if nk.sum()<20: break
        keep=nk
    R,t=kabsch(P[keep],Q[keep]); Xt=(R@X1.T).T+t
    dall=np.linalg.norm(Xt[i]-X2[jj],axis=1)
    return float(np.sum(1/(1+(dall/d0)**2))/min(L1,L2)),R,t
def dp(Xt,gap=-0.6):
    D=np.linalg.norm(Xt[:,None,:]-X2[None,:,:],axis=2); Sm=1/(1+(D/d0)**2)
    F=np.zeros((L1+1,L2+1)); P=np.zeros((L1+1,L2+1),np.int8)
    for i in range(1,L1+1):
        diag=F[i-1,:-1]+Sm[i-1]; up=F[i-1,1:]+gap
        row=F[i]; cur=0.0
        for q in range(1,L2+1):
            a,b=diag[q-1],up[q-1]; c=cur+gap
            if a>=b and a>=c: v,p=a,0
            elif b>=c: v,p=b,1
            else: v,p=c,2
            row[q]=v; P[i,q]=p; cur=v
    cand=max([(F[L1,q],L1,q) for q in range(L2+1)]+[(F[i,L2],i,L2) for i in range(L1+1)])
    _,i,q=cand; pr=[]
    while i>0 and q>0:
        p=P[i,q]
        if p==0: pr.append((i-1,q-1)); i-=1; q-=1
        elif p==1: i-=1
        else: q-=1
    return pr[::-1]
best=(0,None)
for off in range(-(L2-40),L1-40):
    i=np.arange(max(0,off),min(L1,L2+off)); q=i-off
    if len(i)<40: continue
    tm,R,t=fit(list(zip(i,q)))
    if tm>best[0]: best=(tm,(R,t))
print("best gapless-threading seed (sequence-independent): TM-score %.3f"%best[0])
R,t=best[1]
for it in range(6):
    pairs=dp((R@X1.T).T+t); tm,R2,t2=fit(pairs)
    if R2 is None: break
    R,t=R2,t2
print("after %d DP/superposition cycles: TM-score %.3f over %d aligned CA pairs"%(it+1,tm,len(pairs)))
mapsb={int(r1[i]):int(r2[q]) for i,q in pairs}
seqmap={276:147,279:150,336:206,337:207,338:208,339:209,340:210,344:214,356:226,358:228,411:281,
        431:301,445:315,446:316,447:317,448:318,490:362,492:364,493:365,495:367,506:381,507:382}
lbl={276:"KxGQ Lys",279:"KxGQ Gln",336:"beta1",337:"A-rich",338:"A-rich",339:"A-rich",340:"A-rich Ser",
     344:"beta2",356:"beta3",358:"beta3 Lys",411:"alphaC Glu",431:"beta5",445:"hinge",446:"hinge",
     447:"hinge",448:"hinge",490:"cat loop",492:"cat loop",493:"cat Asn",495:"cat loop",506:"DFG-1",507:"Mg Asp"}
print("\nCOQ8A -> ADCK5 mapping, sequence alignment vs sequence-independent structure alignment")
ag=tot=0; rows=[]
for k in sorted(seqmap):
    sb=mapsb.get(k); 
    if sb is None: st="not aligned"
    elif sb==seqmap[k]: st="AGREE"; ag+=1; tot+=1
    else: st="shift %+d"%(sb-seqmap[k]); tot+=1
    rows.append((k,lbl[k],seqmap[k],sb,st))
    print("  COQ8A %3d %-11s -> seq %-4s struct %-6s %s"%(k,lbl[k],seqmap[k],sb,st))
print("agreement: %d / %d aligned diagnostic positions (%.0f%%)"%(ag,tot,100*ag/tot))
open(f"{W}/sb.tsv","w").write("COQ8A\telement\tseq_map\tstruct_map\tstatus\n"+"\n".join("%d\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s"%r for r in rows))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16.5,4.8))
im=ax[0].imshow(pae,cmap="Greens_r",vmin=0,vmax=31)
ax[0].add_patch(plt.Rectangle((130,130),56,56,fill=False,ec="tab:orange",lw=1.8))
ax[0].add_patch(plt.Rectangle((189,189),251,251,fill=False,ec="tab:blue",lw=1.8))
ax[0].add_patch(plt.Rectangle((189,130),251,56,fill=False,ec="crimson",lw=1.8))
ax[0].set_title("ADCK5 AlphaFold PAE\norange KxGQ, blue kinase core, red interdomain")
ax[0].set_xlabel("residue"); ax[0].set_ylabel("residue"); plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax[0],label="PAE (A)")
ks=["within KxGQ","within kinase core","KxGQ vs kinase core","N-term tail vs kinase core"]
vals=[res[k] for k in ks]
ax[1].bar(["within\nKxGQ","within\nkinase","KxGQ vs\nkinase","N-tail vs\nkinase"],vals,color=["tab:orange","tab:blue","crimson","grey"])
ax[1].axhline(5,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax[1].set_ylabel("mean PAE (A)"); ax[1].set_title("Confidence of interdomain placement")
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax[1].text(i,v+0.4,"%.1f"%v,ha="center")
ax[2].scatter(idx,plddt,s=3,c="tab:blue"); ax[2].scatter([147,150],[plddt[146],plddt[149]],s=55,c="crimson",zorder=5)
ax[2].annotate("K147, Q150",(150,plddt[149]),xytext=(250,52),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->"))
ax[2].axhline(70,ls="--",c="grey"); ax[2].set_xlabel("ADCK5 residue"); ax[2].set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax[2].set_title("Per-residue model confidence")
